Epic rules checklist

Every acceptance criterion for this story, confirmed against the shipped create and edit flows.

1

Blocked submission on missing/invalid required fields — AC1

Create and edit both block submit and show an inline error under each offending field when amount, date, or category is missing or invalid; the form stays open.

2

No default value is ever substituted — AC2

A blocked field is left exactly as typed (or blank) — never silently filled with a placeholder value, today's date, or the first category.

3

Zero, negative, and over-2-decimal amounts are blocked — AC3

See the "Validation & category rules" screen's amount matrix — "0", "-12.50", and "19.999" are all blocked with an inline error.

4

No upper limit on a valid amount — AC4

A large value like "1500000.00" (2 decimal places) saves without rejection.

5

Only the fixed category list is offered — AC5

Travel, Meals, Software, Office Supplies, Other — the same five options on every create and edit form.

6

No category management control — AC6

No add, edit, or remove affordance exists for categories anywhere in the product.

7

loggedBy follows the current viewer — AC7

Switching "Signed in as" and then saving a create or edit sets "Logged by" to whoever is currently signed in.

8

Shared visibility, no per-submitter scoping — AC8

Every "Signed in as" value renders the exact same expense list — switching viewers never hides or filters a row.

9

Immediately visible, no workflow state — AC9

A save closes the form and shows the row right away — no "pending approval" badge or intermediate status exists.

10

No attachment or receipt control — AC10

The create/edit form has four fields only: Amount, Category, Date, Description. No file picker, no "add receipt" button.

11

No delete option — AC11

Every row's only action is "Edit"; the edit form's only actions are "Cancel" and "Save changes". No delete control exists anywhere.
